title: Gravitation and Quantum Theory as Emergent Phenomena - An E8 ×ω E8 Theory of Unification
content: I propose that both quantum theory and gravitation are emergent low-energy phenomena arising from a deeper pre-quantum, pre-spacetime dynamics formulated on split bioctonionic geometry with symmetry E8 × ωE8. In this framework, Connes time replaces external classical time, trace dynamics replaces quantum kinematics, and spacetime itself emerges when many atoms of spacetime-matter become sufficiently entangled and undergo a quantum-to-classical transition. The program naturally accommodates three fermion generations, left-right structure, gravi-weak unification, and explicit charged-fermion mass relations. I explain these achievements, identify the principal open problems, and compare the program fairly with string theory. The central claim is that unification may require not quantizing classical spacetime, but deriving both spacetime geometry and quantum mechanics from a more primitive octonionic dynamics.
